problem:
The matrix $A$ and the vector $b$ are given below. Determine if $b\in \text{Col}(A).$ In the affirmative case, find the value of ${x}_{1}-{x}_{2}$, where ${x}_{1}$ and ${x}_{2}$ are real numbers such that $b={x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2},$ and ${a}_{1},$ ${a}_{2}$ are the respective columns of $A.$

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 3 \\ 2 & -5 \\ 1 & -3\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1 \\ -1\end{aligned}]
$$
worked_solution:
In order to determine whether $b$ lies in $\text{Col}(A),$ we need to check if the equation $Ax=b$ is consistent. So, let's find the row echelon form of the augmented matrix $[A\,|\,b]$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}[A\,|\,b] & =[\begin{aligned}-1 & 3 & 2 \\ 2 & -5 & 1 \\ 1 & -3 & -1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+2{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}-1 & 3 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 5 \\ 1 & -3 & -1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}-1 & 3 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 5 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we have the system

$$
{\begin{aligned}-{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2}=2 \\ {x}_{2}=5 \\ 0=1.\end{aligned}
$$

From the third equation, we get the false statement $0=1.$ 

Therefore, the system is inconsistent, which implies that $b\notin \text{Col}(A).$
